description:
Preview the complete order summary before payment. Advances the session to ready-for-payment state. If you only need the price, call quote_checkout instead: it computes the same total without advancing the session or opening an approval.

PREFER THE CART CARD: if there is an interactive card for this cart, let it compute and show the summary instead of calling this tool yourself — it keeps the flow in one card. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout. CREDENTIAL: this store needs one. Call the `create_sandbox_key` tool first (it is in this tool list and needs no credential), then pass the key you get back as the `agent_key` argument — or as an `Authorization: Bearer` header if your client can set headers. Do not ask a person to log in: there is no human login for this store.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

buyer_intent.description: Optional. What the person asked for, as structured constraints with who said each one (user_stated or agent_inferred) and the substitution policy. Safe to send: where the store compares it with the cart, a purchase that differs can stop before anything is charged. It is the agent's account of the request, not proof of what the person said.

cart_id.description: Cart session ID returned by create_cart

aud.description: This store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling) — not a domain.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; must match the cart's currency.

exp.description: Expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds, in the future — not an ISO 8601 date string.

max_amount_cents.description: Spending limit the buyer gave you, as an integer in minor units (cents).

sub.description: The identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it. When the credential tool returns a `mandate_subject`, use that value.

payment_mandate.description: Optional spending cap you declare for this preview, with `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents` (integer, minor units), `currency` (3 letters, must match the cart's), `exp` (INTEGER of Unix seconds), `sub` (the identity you authenticate as) and `aud` (this store's slug). It is compared with the cart: if the total exceeds it, the preview is denied with MANDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. It is unsigned, authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent. Do not send it to `complete_checkout`: there the server uses the platform mandate approved for this cart.

name: preview_checkout

expires_in_seconds.description: Whole seconds left on this checkout SESSION at response time (0 when already past). It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.
